purpose: Teach: 下方/私鉄/郵貯/竣工/インサイド/四方/ロイター/パーフェクト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業績下方修正を経験された
lines.en: Dad experienced a performance downgrade early on, didn't he.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Light weight on the memory. Speaking as if laying out a fact he's held for decades. Slight pause before the question—not urgent, waiting for confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは私鉄沿線に店を構えた
lines.en: Yes. He opened his first store along the private railway line.
lines.style: Steady, direct response. Slight lift of pride on the location detail. Speaking plainly, as if the choice itself contained wisdom. Not performing—simply stating what was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、郵貯口座を最初に使われた経営者だ
lines.en: He was one of the first managers to use postal savings accounts.
lines.style: Quiet admiration underlying the words. Slow pace. Emphasis lands softly on 'first'—not boastful, just noting the foresight. Trailing slightly at the end, as if remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは竣工式を盛大に祝われた
lines.en: Yes. He celebrated the opening ceremony with real grandeur.
lines.style: Reflective, almost tender. Speaking as if seeing the memory clearly. Pause before 'grandeur'—selecting the word with care. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界インサイド情報を読み解く名手だった
lines.en: He had a gift for reading between the lines in the industry.
lines.style: Slow, admiring tempo. Weight on 'gift'—real recognition in the voice. The kind of respect you give to intelligence you've watched work. Trailing off slightly—the memory lands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは四方の競合を分析された
lines.en: Yes. He studied every competitor, from all angles.
lines.style: Grounded confirmation. Slight emphasis on 'all angles'—precision mattered to him. Speaking with the certainty of someone who watched this habit daily. Calm, methodical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ロイター記事を毎朝確認された
lines.en: Every morning he'd review the Reuters reports.
lines.style: Quiet, almost routine in the telling. As if that early-morning discipline is still vivid. Slight pause before 'Reuters'—the specific detail carries weight. Gentle fade at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはパーフェクトな経営を目指された
lines.en: Yes. He aimed for nothing less than perfect management.
lines.style: Final statement, measured and clear. Weight settles on 'perfect'—not as criticism but as recognition of his standard. Composed, honoring. This closes something. Breath is steady, intentional.
